newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Agis widens stake in Neca.
newsitem.headline: Agis widens stake in Neca.

text.p: Israel's Agis Industries said on Monday it had reached an agreement to buy an additional 56 percent stake in Neca Chemicals Ltd for $3.4 million and planned to acquire all of the firm.

Arkin managing director Maury Arkin told Reuters his company already has a 30 percent holding in Neca, Israel's leading producer of personal products and a major force in detergents and household cleaning products.

"We hope in the end to hold of all the company and to merge our operations," he said after Agis announced to the Tel Aviv stock exchange it had reached an agreement with controlling shareholders of Neca to acquire their stakes for $47.19 a share.
Agis, which manufacturers pharmaceuticals and cosmetics, informed the bourse it intends to make an offer to acquire the remaining shares in public hands, but gave no price or date.
Neca controls 40 percent of the local soap market and exports to Europe, Asia and North America.
